provenance: Generated for this project by SourceData/VFX/Blender/slice_*.py in Blender 5.2.4 headless (bpy mesh + FBX export; Workbench renders of curve geometry via slice_render.py; chain* entries are art-direction candidate elements; numpy 2.x raster and noise with fixed seeds); no third-party material.

assets.purpose: Basic attack combo stage 1: short flat crescent, swings right to left (head on the left of forward).
assets.usage: StaticMeshComponent attached to the character at chest height (or spawned at the muzzle transform), unlit translucent two-sided material using tex_slash_edge; scroll U / dissolve with tex_dissolve_noise over ~0.18 s; rotate with the character facing.
assets.pivot: swing origin = chest height = mesh origin (0,0,0)
assets.orientation: arc lies in the XY plane (z = 0), character forward = +X, +Y = left of forward
assets.uv: UV0: U along the arc 0 = head (leading end) -> 1 = tail; V across 0 = inner edge -> 1 = outer cutting edge (as seen in Unreal; Blender stores 1 - V)
assets.extents_cm: x 50..96 (ellipse a = 96, b = 58), width up to 26, sweep 110 degrees
assets.budget: 576 triangles, one translucent surface, area about 1.4 m2 equivalent at 26 cm wide (thin crescent)
assets.sha256_note: sha256 is the committed FBX bytes; regenerating changes it (FBX creation timestamp), geometry_sha256 is the reproducible check
assets.fbx_export: Blender 5.2.4 export_scene.fbx: apply_unit_scale, scale_length 0.01, axis_forward X, axis_up Z, mesh_smooth_type FACE, no leaf bones; verify orientation after import (see HANDOFF)

assets.orientation: XY plane, forward +X, head on the right of forward
assets.extents_cm: x 50..106 (a = 106, b = 66), width up to 30, sweep 118 degrees
assets.sha256_note: sha256 is the committed FBX bytes; regenerating changes it (FBX creation timestamp), geometry_sha256 is the reproducible check

assets.purpose: Basic attack finisher: wide heavy crescent with a thickened leading edge plus a detached echo blade.
assets.usage: As stage 1 but slower (about 0.28 s), with a hold at the thickest point; the echo blade is part of the same mesh and shares the material.
assets.pivot: swing origin = chest height = mesh origin
assets.orientation: XY plane, forward +X, head on the left of forward, sweep wraps about 184 degrees
assets.uv: as stage 1 for both ribbons (main + echo)
assets.extents_cm: a = 128, b = 104, main width up to 64 x 1.4 leading-edge bulge, echo width 16

assets.purpose: Slash ribbon texture for the three combo meshes: white-hot band along the outer cutting edge, element-colour streaks toward the inner edge, wide ink band outside the cutting edge, dark speed streaks, tapering tail.
assets.usage: Sampled with the mesh UV0; U (x) is head 0 -> tail 1; scroll or dissolve using tex_dissolve_noise.G streaks. Translucent, unlit.
assets.uv: x = U (head 0 -> tail 1), row 0 = V 0 = inner edge, last row = outer edge
assets.alpha_packing: RGB = glow mask (R = G = B; 0 ink only, 0.6 element body, 1.0 white-hot core), A = coverage; ink = A > 0 with RGB = 0
assets.compression: TC_Default (BC3/DXT5 with alpha) as the existing hit masks; TC_BC7 recommended for thin-line sheets
assets.streaming: NeverStream = true, LODGroup Effects (same as VfxApplySettings)
assets.budget: translucent overdraw: one ribbon surface per swing; 4 players swinging at once ~ 4 x 1.4 m2 equivalent
assets.material_hint: Same graph as the existing Layer material: emissive = Glow * tex.rgb (+ white lerp above 0.8) + Ink, opacity = tex.a * Fade, translucent unlit, two-sided. Recommended glow remap: color = lerp(Glow * saturate(g / 0.6), 1, smoothstep(0.8, 1.0, g)); Ink (0A0B0D) shows where g = 0 and A > 0.

assets.purpose: Tileable erosion / dissolve utility: R = blobby fBm, G = streaks stretched along texture X (U), B = cellular crackle.
assets.usage: Sample with tiling UV, compare against a progress parameter (opacity = A * step(progress, noise)); G is the along-arc streak dissolve for slashes and jets.
assets.uv: tiles in both axes (periodic noise lattice)
assets.alpha_packing: RGB = three independent noise channels in [0,1], A = 1 (utility mask, not a glow mask)
